name: ai-canvas
description: A local-first, agent-driven image creation workspace.
author: Local AI Canvas Project

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:ah1-eval: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/unit/agent-eval-harness.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/agent-eval-catalog.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:product-eval: vitest run --config vitest.product-eval.config.ts && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.product-eval.config.ts
scripts.test:product-reliability: vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/product-1-f-project-cycles.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.product-reliability.config.ts
scripts.test:product-security: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/unit/security-redaction.test.ts tests/unit/renderer-network-boundary.test.ts tests/unit/agent-recovery.test.ts tests/unit/agent-atomic-tools.test.ts tests/unit/provider-agent-p0.test.ts tests/unit/ipc-contracts.test.ts tests/unit/krill-http-transport.test.ts tests/unit/ark-http-multipart.test.ts tests/unit/provider-contracts.test.ts tests/unit/provider-usage-ledger.test.ts tests/unit/context-builder.test.ts tests/unit/diagnostic-export-service.test.ts tests/unit/outbound-image-audit.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/agent-runtime.test.ts tests/integration/generation-queue.test.ts tests/integration/project-storage.test.ts tests/integration/product-provider-runtime.test.ts tests/integration/agent-context-repository.test.ts tests/integration/generation-agent-workflow-runtime.test.ts tests/integration/persistent-agent-loop.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.product-security.config.ts
